page: Microsoft Azure DC96as_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCasv6 server family. Powered by an AMD x86_64 processor, this instance features 96 dedicated virtual CPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The underlying virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external volumes, with the instance being Premium Storage capable. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the DC96as_v6 is classified as a general-purpose instance. It is designed for workloads requiring substantial parallel processing capabilities without specialized hardware acceleration, such as enterprise application hosting, large-scale web serving, and distributed microservices. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance, making it a resource-dense option for multi-threaded enterprise workloads.
